baseline.source: v1.1.5's closing sweep, S13's (DL-184), standing as the closing sweep at the re-close (DL-185): 50 games of 20 years in 8 processes, the replay kept

run.source: v1.1.5's Gate sweeps, S3 to S13, each 50 games of 20 years (DL-177 to DL-184); the gate profile (DL-186 item 13)

refusals.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): the policy chooses only what the rules accept, so a refusal is a bug; 0 at v1.1.5's close (DL-184)

invalid.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): a game the validator refuses; 0 at every close; read only when validated after every advance, which a Gate run is not (v1.1.5's was not)

stopped.source: M6-S3's harness assertion (DL-59, DL-69): no hero.transferred names the player's Guild; 0 at v1.1.5's close (DL-184)

unfinished.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every game ends or plays to its last Turn; 50 of 50 at v1.1.5's close (DL-184)

roundTrips.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every last save loads and serialises back identically; 50 of 50 at v1.1.5's close (DL-184)

replay.source: M2-S12 (DL-34), one game at a time since v1.1.5-S10 (DL-181): seed-0001 identical at v1.1.5's close, 144,371,849 characters (DL-184)

traitsPerCareer.source: v1.1.5's closing sweep: 2.178, 1,472 Traits over 676 careers (DL-184), S5's 2.32 baseline (the owner's steer, DL-179) less the XP split's 0.144; the band, the baseline ±0.10, is the agent's proposal: a change of no effect moved it 0.007 (v1.1.5-S4, DL-178)

playerBankruptcies.source: v1.1.5's closing sweep: 0 of 50 (DL-184); at most 3, the baseline and fifty seeds' ±3 (DL-166), is the agent's proposal; DL-168 item 16's 3 to 7 decided what followed v1.1.5 and is not this line

saveGzipped.source: data-model §7 (DL-84): a save after 20 years under 20 MiB, measured gzipped as the page keeps it (DL-67, DL-186 item 21); the mean over the run's games, the agent's reading; v1.1.5's closing sweep: mean 17.95 MiB, max 21.08 MiB (DL-184's report)

saveGrowth.source: DL-186 item 21: the uncompressed mean after 20 years, held between releases; v1.1.5's closing sweep: 143,329,439 characters, 136.69 MiB (DL-184's report); at most 10% more without a DL entry is the agent's proposal

noOneFalls.source: v1.1.4-S5 (DL-156): every chance within 2 points of the resolver's rate with no one falling; held at v1.1.5's re-close, the widest 1.18 points (DL-185)

moraleInQuest.source: v1.1.5-S7 (DL-173, the owner's answer): the Quest's bands and success within 3 points with Morale's consequences in; held at v1.1.5's re-close, the widest 1.61 points (DL-185)

notes: Drafted by v1.1.6-S2 (DL-188) from v1.1.5's epic and closing sweep. It binds once the owner approves it; its baselines change only with a DL entry (DL-186 item 13).
The bands are set on the run above: on a run of another shape they read not comparable. The estimate's two limits are checked by npm run harness -- estimate, not by a gate run.
S17 adds the per-Turn copy's time threshold when it lands (DL-186 item 11).
